explicit_exclusions.reason: M3BQ cleared mapping/tensors but found no retained training-worthy labels; at-least-two gate failed.
Prior generalization diagnosis selected downselection; broad 25-label retry is not justified by existing local evidence.
Local support is strong, but existing receipts already show train-fit with weak held-out signer-disjoint behavior and Detector 0/crop-normalization held-out failure.
The local selected set has min_clips_per_label 1 in train, validation, and test and no label with at least two clips per split.
ASL-LEX sign reference videos require explicit permission, SemLex is absent from the source register, and no repo-local approved phonology/training artifact exists.
Kaggle/static ASL and unreviewed public datasets remain blocked until dataset-specific rights/provenance review and local evidence exist.
Mixed/Wikimedia/CIRA/Internet Archive negative challenge sources are approved only for validation/pilot evidence, not model training.
Browser/product fail-closed artifacts and stale proof surfaces do not supply training manifests, source approval, and tensor evidence for a new subset.
M3BR is restricted to existing local approved artifacts; any nonlocal, unreviewed, or non-reviewable artifact fails closed.

candidate_subset_decision.reason: No existing local approved artifact provides at least two labels that are both source-approved, locally materialized, sufficiently split-supported, and clear of the current held-out/failure gates. PopSign has support but repeated held-out failure; ASL Citizen 25 failed broad generalization; ASL Citizen seven-label high-signal failed retained-label gates; WLASL selected is too sparse; first-party has no current local training artifacts; SemLex/ASL-LEX and other public/static sources are blocked or absent.

remaining_gates_before_any_future_subset.requirement: At least two labels must have approved local source rights, reviewable train/validation/test manifests, tensors, and split/signature support before any manifest/tensor contract or training receipt.
At least two labels must clear mapping, split/domain, tensor/stat, local quality, and prior held-out gates.
Low-signal, dark, ambiguous, or source-quality-suspect rows must be repaired, dropped, replaced, or manually reviewed before claiming training readiness.
Any selected subset must bind an input/crop contract whose held-out crop-stat and ROI evidence is clear enough for a training receipt.
No pretrained CV/sign/landmark dependency, generated pseudo-label, browser activation, model-card promotion, or final-gate weakening may enter the promoted lane.

Future training requires a separate receipt with exact command, data paths, expected signal, stop condition, artifact copyback, and validation plan; Brev additionally requires worker state, listed price, max runtime, max spend, kill condition, cleanup/default-off verification, duplicate-worker avoidance, and current human approval.

brev_assessment.reason: No 2+ label training-worthy local subset exists, and the active M3BR prompt forbids Brev commands. Remote compute would not answer the current blocker.
missing_receipt_fields_before_remote_exe: current human approval for this specific remote run

next_action_rationale: The next useful step is not another local training receipt or Brev receipt. The project needs supported training data: either new approved first-party/source artifacts, annotation/quality repair that creates a reviewable 2+ label subset, or a human-approved source/data strategy that produces such artifacts.
